titles.en: Inscription on the Hot Spring, Tang rubbing fragment

currentCollection.note: Shi Anchang’s study identifies the rubbing he inspected at the Bibliothèque nationale de France as P.4508.
currentCollection.noteZh: 施安昌的实物研究将法国国家图书馆所藏这件拓本著录为 P.4508。

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft with a firsthand study of the Paris rubbing. The present BnF catalogue entry and precise production date still need checking.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：草稿已增补在巴黎查阅实物的研究，仍待核对法国国家图书馆现行目录及具体拓制年代。

notes: A relative dating claim in the news report still requires comparison with other early rubbings.
The original stone is lost; the record therefore makes no claim about the stone’s location.
The rubbing’s route from the Dunhuang library cave to Paris is not described in the cited report.
notesZh: 报道所述的最早存世拓本说法，仍须与其他早期拓本比较。
原石已佚，故本条不对原石所在作任何主张。
所引报道没有叙述此卷自敦煌藏经洞到巴黎的经过。
